title: Open the Tier 8 mastery trials
description:
Choose one legendary threat and learn its telegraphs. Ancient Remnant and Ender Guardian are Tier 7; Maledictus and Leviathan are Tier 8, Scylla is Tier 9. A party is optional.

Open the Tier 8 mastery trials.

This entry records that you read the advice. It does not detect a fight, gear quality, a completed expedition or a claimed reward.
